Tickets for the 2026 Skechers World Champions Cup supporting Shriners Children's are now on sale!

All tickets and parking for the Skechers World Champions Cup supporting Shriners Children's are digital and accessible on a mobile phone only. No screenshots or print outs are allowed to gain access to the tournament.

Save more money by purchasing ten or more tickets by contacting grouptickets@worldchampionscup.com.

We’ve got miles of front row seating. Whether you’re following your favorite golfer throughout the course or watching the action from the first tee, enjoy being in the midst of the energy and excitement of our tournament.

Enjoy the tournament from the best seats on the course. Skechers Captains Club members receive exclusive access to the Feather Sound Country Club Clubhouse, featuring panoramic views of the tournament's finishing hole, premium food offerings, a full open bar, and elegant indoor and outdoor hospitality spaces.

Members also enjoy access to the VIP Viewing Deck at Hole 2, offering prime sightlines to Holes 2 and 5 with complimentary beverages throughout the day.

General Parking is available for purchase Thursday, Friday, and Sunday during tournament play and will be located at our Public Parking Partner Lot, The FEIL Organization, which will be located ay 570 Carillon Pkwy, Saint Petersburg, FL 33716.

We are pleased to offer complimentary admission for up to four (4) youth, ages fifteen (15) and under when accompanied by a ticketed adult.

Youth have free ground access only. They do not need a ticket to enter!

Admission into a hospitality venue will require an appropriate ticket, for youth ages five (5) and over.

No re-entry. No rain check privileges. Prices and gate times subject to change.

Youth have free ground access only. They do not need a ticket to enter!
All sales are final. There are no refunds, no exchanges and no replacements for lost/stolen tickets or inclement weather.

Folds of Honor Military & First Responder Tickets

 

Complimentary tickets are available to military members and first responders in partnership with Folds of Honor. These tickets are available for active, reserve, retired and veteran military along with one guest, while tickets last, and are available for one day only. First responders including firefighters, law enforcement officers, paramedics, emergency medical technicians and one guest also have the option to claim free tickets for one day only while tickets last.
